categories.name: Lock-in period
categories.high_if: Only the tenant is locked in, or leaving early costs the whole deposit or more than one month's rent
categories.medium_if: Lock-in applies to both sides but is long, or the early-exit cost is unclear

categories.name: Security deposit amount
categories.high_if: Deposit is above a legal limit stated in the city profile, or far above both the city norm and the Model Tenancy Act benchmark of two months' rent
categories.medium_if: Deposit is above the Model Tenancy Act benchmark of two months' rent (or above the state's default stated in the city profile)

categories.name: Deposit deductions
categories.high_if: Deductions are at the landlord's discretion ('as the Lessor may deem fit') or have no limit
categories.medium_if: Deductions are listed but vague (e.g. 'damages' with no mention of normal wear and tear)

categories.name: Deposit refund timeline
categories.missing_if: No date or number of days for refunding the deposit

categories.name: Notice period
categories.high_if: Tenant and landlord have different notice periods, two clauses give different notice periods, or a heavy penalty applies for short notice
categories.medium_if: Notice period is long (more than two months)
categories.missing_if: No notice period for one or both sides

categories.name: Rent increase
categories.high_if: Rent can be revised at any time or by any amount
categories.medium_if: Increase is stated but the percentage or timing is unclear
categories.missing_if: Nothing is said about rent on renewal

categories.name: Maintenance and repairs
categories.high_if: Tenant pays for all repairs, including structural or major ones
categories.medium_if: Split between tenant and landlord is unclear
categories.missing_if: Nothing says who pays maintenance or repairs

categories.name: Painting and cleaning charges
categories.medium_if: A fixed painting charge (e.g. one month's rent) regardless of how long the tenant stayed, or painting at the tenant's cost with no limit

categories.name: Landlord entry
categories.medium_if: Landlord or agents can enter without notice, or at any time

categories.name: Late fees and penalties
categories.high_if: Penalty with no upper limit that can grow larger than a month's rent
categories.medium_if: Daily or large late fee, or no grace period

categories.name: Annexures and inventory
categories.high_if: An annexure or inventory list is referred to but not attached, and the tenant can be charged against it
categories.medium_if: Furnished flat with no inventory list

categories.name: Registration and required filings
categories.medium_if: The city profile says a registration or filing is required (registration, Rent Authority filing, police verification) and the agreement does not mention it

categories.name: Other
categories.high_if: Any other clause that could cost the tenant significant money or stop them leaving
categories.medium_if: Any other one-sided, vague or unusual clause worth asking about

fairness_rules.one_sided: A right or duty applies to only one side without a reason
fairness_rules.vague: Amounts, conditions or timelines are left to one side's discretion
fairness_rules.unlimited: A charge or increase has no upper limit
